asked.item: No post after pasting Text context

verdict.reason: The FAQ says Text context does not create a post by itself. It also says how to check that the source loaded and how to ask for a draft.

steps.text: Adding Text context does not generate a post automatically.
Confirm the source finished loading and its checkbox is selected in Context.
Enter "Create 1 LinkedIn post from my selected context. Keep it as a draft." in the AI Agent prompt box, replacing LinkedIn with your destination.
Review the draft card before publishing.
